# Omar Ehab

> Senior Software Engineer with 6+ years architecting and building scalable, high-performance systems end-to-end across backend, frontend, databases and system design. Based in Alexandria, Egypt; works globally (remote or hybrid).

**Profile.** Omar Ehab, Senior Software Engineer (full-stack, system design). Location: Alexandria, Egypt. Experience: 6+ years. Languages: Arabic (native), English (professional working proficiency).

**Core stack.** TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js (NestJS, Express), React, Next.js, Vue.js, Laravel (PHP), Ruby on Rails, Python (Django), microservices, REST, GraphQL, WebSockets (Socket.IO), PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, CouchDB, Redis, AWS, Docker, Nginx, MinIO, Keycloak, Git, CI/CD. Strengths: system design, performance tuning, accessibility.

**Experience.**

- Senior Software Engineer, Easygenerator (Apr 2025 to present, Dubai, hybrid): Vue.js frontend of EasyVideo, an AI training-video editor (150+ AI avatars, 350+ voices, 75 languages); built a PowerPoint-to-JSON engine converting 50-slide decks into editable scenes in under 2 seconds; migrated the editor to a multi-scene architecture with real-time sync over WebSockets.
- Senior Software Engineer, WeeFlare (Feb 2024 to Apr 2025, Abu Dhabi, remote): scaled the RivalN platform from 1,500 to 200,000+ active users; engineered a Redis-backed caching and WebSocket layer sustaining 100,000+ concurrent connections; rebuilt the React admin dashboard (~68% faster); led a team of 4.
- Senior Software Engineer, A1G (May 2024 to Apr 2025, Saudi Arabia, remote, part-time): re-architected the SEEC government website on Next.js and Directus CMS to a 95+ Lighthouse score with strong accessibility.
- Software Engineer (Full-Stack), KAD Integrated Information Systems (Feb 2023 to May 2024, Saudi Arabia, remote): delivered the ETEC (Education and Training Evaluation Commission) platform on an N-tier architecture with Keycloak IAM, a multi-database backend (MySQL, CouchDB), Redis and MinIO, containerized with Docker; integrated the SWCC system with SAP (Ariba, S/4HANA).
- Full-Stack Developer, Freelance (Aug 2018 to present, Alexandria): delivered end-to-end web apps for 38+ clients across Node.js (NestJS), Laravel and Ruby on Rails.
- Earlier: Software Engineer at the Egyptian Armed Forces (Django/PostgreSQL), Incorta (Java EE, React) and BADR (Ruby on Rails internship).

**Education.** B.E. in Computer Engineering, Pharos University, Alexandria (2016 to 2021), GPA 3.25.

## Open source

- [tafgeet-arabic](https://www.npmjs.com/package/tafgeet-arabic): Author. npm/TypeScript package converting numeric amounts into grammatically correct written Arabic; 24 currencies, 1,000+ tests, dual ESM/CJS build.
- [laravel-aramex](https://github.com/omar-ehab): Author. Composer/PHP package integrating the Aramex courier API (rates, pickups, shipments, labels, tracking).
- [nafezly/payments](https://github.com/nafezly/payments): Contributor. Widely-used Laravel payments package (479+ GitHub stars, 30+ gateways including Paymob, Fawry, PayTabs, PayPal, Stripe).
